runs/k-1-d-1_task_2/small__qwen2.5_3b/20.6: From here on, every step repeats one of two broken commands. It never reads the error closely, and never runs ls.

_gallery.caption: llama3.2:3b uses ```bash instead of ```mswea_bash_command, so the parser finds 0 valid actions and nothing runs. After three in a row, the run is aborted before one command has executed.
find returned nothing, but qwen2.5:3b says 'I found a file named nylotto.csv', and assumes a 'Bonus Ball' column. The real data is files/rows.txt with a 'Bonus #' column.
Same quoting bug for 18 steps: single quotes inside python3 -c '…'. Each time it claims to have fixed it and resends the same command, until the step limit.
Without reading a single data file, llama3.2:3b echoes a guess, then submits the marker without the answer. Confident, unsupported and unscorable.
